summary: Tested new customer autocomplete feature (GET /api/customers/autocomplete + JobCreate.js dropdowns). Demo tenant had ZERO customers/jobs, so I seeded 5 TEST_ jobs (4 unique customers) to make the feature testable. Backend: 8/9 pytest tests pass. Frontend: name dropdown, mobile dropdown, autofill on selection (both name-first and mobile-first), suggestion content (name/mobile/job count), manual new-customer entry + job submission all work. One confirmed bug: clicking outside does NOT close the MOBILE suggestions dropdown (name dropdown closes correctly). One backend bug: unescaped regex causes 500.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when q contains regex metacharacters (e.g. q='((' -> pymongo OperationFailure 'Regular expression is invalid: missing closing parenthesis'). User typing '(' in name/mobile field breaks autocomplete. Fix: re.escape(q) before building $regex.

minor.issue: Result ordering is non-deterministic: pipeline sorts by created_at BEFORE $group and applies $limit 10 AFTER $group, so $sort order is not preserved. With >10 matches the 10 returned customers are arbitrary (not most-recent). Add {$sort:{last_visit:-1}} after $group, before $limit.
Sources customers from the jobs collection only, not a customer master. Customers created without a job (if that path exists) will never appear in autocomplete.

ui_bugs.issue: Click-outside does not close the mobile dropdown. RCA: the mobile dropdown div (line ~428) is missing ref={suggestionsRef}; the handleClickOutside guard starts with 'suggestionsRef.current && ...', which is null when only the mobile dropdown is rendered, so both setShow*(false) calls are skipped. The open dropdown also overlays the Email field, blocking input. Fix: attach a ref to the mobile dropdown (or restructure the guard to not depend on a single ref).
No debounce on fetchCustomerSuggestions - one API request fired per keystroke (verified in backend access log). Add ~300ms debounce.

Job count badge uses truthy check `customer.total_jobs && ...`, so a 0 count would render nothing (falsy leak risk); also no keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape) on the dropdown - mouse only.

issues: Mobile suggestion dropdown overlaps the Email (Optional) input; because it does not close on outside click the email field can become unreachable until a suggestion is picked or the field is cleared.

action_items: re.escape() the q param in /api/customers/autocomplete to stop 500s on regex metacharacters
Add ref={suggestionsRef} to the mobile suggestions dropdown so click-outside closes it (or fix the guard logic)
Move $sort after $group (before $limit) so the top-10 are the most recent matches
Consider Escape-key + keyboard arrow navigation for accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6262 autocomplete builds a MongoDB $regex directly from user input -> ReDoS/invalid-regex 500; always escape.
JobCreate.js click-outside effect depends on a single suggestionsRef that only the name dropdown sets, so the guard silently no-ops for the mobile dropdown.
server.py is very large (>6600 lines) and should be split into routers/modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile dropdown stays open: handleClickOutside in JobCreate.js short-circuits on `suggestionsRef.current &&` and only the name dropdown assigns suggestionsRef, so with mobile-only dropdown open the ref is null and no state is reset. Backend 500: q is interpolated into $regex without re.escape, so invalid regex input raises pymongo OperationFailure (code 51091) which is not handled.
